contentText: China's President Xi Jinping on Wednesday pledged to stand up against trade protectionism and said regional economies needed to stand up to rising unilateralism in what France 24's Kethevane Gorjestani says was a "a not so veiled criticism of the US". Xi's comments came APEC summit in Shenzhen, China, where a highly anticipated trilateral meeting between Xi, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin is set to take place on Thursday.
